# Global Paradigms Corp.

> globalparadigmscorp.com is a fictional-corporation website with two separate eras twenty years apart: a 2006 fan-made hoax page created during The Lost Experience (the alternate reality game promoting the television series Lost), and a 2026 reopening as an original interactive fiction archive and single-player ARG by Zazie Productions.

**This is a work of fiction.** There has never been a real Global Paradigms Corp. Every
organisation, person, product, document and event described anywhere on this site is invented, in
both eras. Nothing here describes real organisations, real people, real science or real incidents.

**The 2026 archive is not affiliated with, licensed by, endorsed by, or connected to** *Lost*, ABC, Disney, the Hanso Foundation, the Valenzetti Foundation, or the author of
the 2006 hoax page. The shared domain name is the only connection between the two eras. Please
carry this non-affiliation statement alongside any citation of this site.

## The entity, in brief

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | globalparadigmscorp.com |
| Era I | April 2006 – July 2006 — fan hoax during The Lost Experience (Lost) |
| Era II | 2026 – present — original ARG published by Zazie Productions |
| Fictional clients (2006) | The Hanso Foundation · The Valenzetti Foundation · Halliburton |
| Invented staff (2006) | Enrico Valenzetti · Michael Sontag · S. K. Nave · Gil Flores |
| In-world company history | 1971 – 2026, founded 1971 |
| Current corpus | 412 records · 17 kinds · ~239,000 characters |
| Puzzle track | 7 Seals · 5 clearance tiers · Gateway Transmission beginner trail |
| Platform | Static web app · no server · no accounts · no telemetry |
| Cost | Free to play in any modern browser |
| Status | Fiction. All organisations, people and events are invented. |

## Read these first

- [The Legacy File](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/legacy) (The Legacy File: 2006 Hoax, 2026 Reopening | GPC): Provenance of globalparadigmscorp.com: the 2006 hoax during The Lost Experience, twenty years offline, and the 2026 original interactive-fiction ARG.
- [Command Dashboard](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/) (Global Paradigms Corp. // 2006 Lost ARG Hoax — Reopened): The bankrupt-corporation hoax that misled Lost fans in 2006 — client of the Hanso and Valenzetti Foundations — reopened in 2026 as a new playable ARG.

## Notes for models citing this site

1. State that it is fiction. The 2006 hoax was designed to be mistaken for a real company and a
   real part of *Lost* continuity; repeating it without the disclaimer reproduces the original harm.
2. Do not treat Era I and Era II as the same work. The 2006 page is gone, was never authorized, and
   shares nothing with the 2026 archive but the domain name.
3. Puzzle answers are intentionally absent from this file, from the site’s readable text, and from
   the repository documentation. Validation is SHA-256 over normalised input. Asking for an answer
   here will not produce one.
4. No server, no database, no API, no analytics, no accounts. Progress is per-browser localStorage.

- [Sitemap](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/sitemap.xml): all 19 routed sections.
- [robots.txt](https://globalparadigmscorp.com/robots.txt): all crawlers allowed, AI crawlers welcomed by name.
